title: Gene Expression Analysis in Agouti Mice Using Quantitative RT-PCR
author: Kira V. Derkach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xrnfm5e
materials: Data analysis is performed using the 7500 Software v2.0.6 and the Expression Suite Software v1.0.3. All the data are presented as relative mRNA level of the target gene (RQ). The calculation of the expression level of the target gene produced by the method of ΔΔCT (Schmittgen, Livak, 2008): ΔCT =CT gene of interest – CT endogenous control ΔΔCT = ΔCT sample or control – ΔCT control mean RQ= 2 -ΔΔCT To calculate the RQ values for the control and experimental groups, the mean ΔCT control is calculated, which is subtracted from all the control and experimental ΔCT.

steps.title: Collect and Store Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Decapitate animals and immediately remove hypothalamus and liver sections.

substeps.instruction: Freeze sections immediately at -80°C before analysis.

steps.title: Isolate Total RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from the hypothalamus and liver sections using ExtractRNA Reagent (TRIzol analogue, Evrogen, Moscow, Russia) following the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Reverse Transcribe RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse-transcribe 1 μg of RNA to cDNA using the MMLV RT kit (Evrogen, Moscow, Russia) and random oligodeoxynucleotide primers according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction Mixture
steps.instruction: Assemble the reaction mixture in a 200 µl PCR-tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µl of qPCRmix-HS SYBR+LowROX (Evrogen, Moscow, Russia).
Add 6 µl of forward and reverse primer mixture (final concentration 0.4 µM each).
Add 3 µl of sample containing 30 ng of cDNA (or distilled water for control samples).
Mix the solution by pipetting and perform a quick spin.

steps.title: Load 96-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Distribute the reaction mixture into a 96-well plate and seal.

substeps.instruction: Dispense the 75 µl reaction mixture into three wells (25 µl per well).
Cover the plate with a seal for qPCR plates.
Briefly mix and centrifuge the plate in a centrifuge/vortex for PCR plates to ensure the mixture is at the bottom and bubble-free.

steps.title: Perform Quantitative RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Run the samples in the Applied Biosystems® 7500 Real-Time PCR System using the specified amplification protocol.

substeps.instruction: 38 cycles of: 95 °C for 30 s, 55–58 °C for 10 s (annealing temperature depends on specific primer pair), and 72 °C for 30 s.
Run the ABI Melt Curve program to verify a single peak and the absence of primer-dimer formation.
